dedupe_keys.name: optimization based design of insulating cementitious foams combined with phase change materials for nzebs

description: Facundo Bre, Antonio Caggiano and Eduardus Koenders apply multi-objective optimisation to insulating cementitious foams combined with phase-change materials. The case uses BESTEST 900 from ASHRAE Standard 140-2011 under Sofia climate conditions. NSGA-II is coupled with EnergyPlus to optimise foam thickness, PCM thickness and melting temperature against annual heating and cooling loads. The abstract reports an 8.95% reduction in total annual loads for a design with 10 cm foam and 2.5 cm PCM melting at 24.41 °C. This is a benchmark simulation result, not measured savings in an occupied Sofia building. Zenodo provides the conference paper freely under CC BY 4.0. Related PCM panel datasets concern other designs and are not assumed to contain this case’s exact files. A limitation is that full assumptions, weather vintage and reproducibility information were not inspected. No PDF or simulation file was downloaded.
